phrases.text: Fortnite got a new update this week, Golden Week starts today, and the Item Shop dropped 17 collabs, from Overwatch and One-Punch Man to Daft Punk and Solo Leveling.
This is everything that happened from November 22nd to November 28th, straight from Epic's in-game news and Item Shop.
Let's get into it!
First, the game. On November 26th, Fortnite moved from version 43.10 to version 43.11.
The official map didn't change with it: still the same 16 places.
The big news tile this week showed up on November 24th: Golden Week and Community Day.
Starting 11/28, refreshed loot meets unvaulted Treasure during Golden Week,
phrases.say: Starting November 28th, refreshed loot meets unvaulted Treasure during Golden Week,

phrases.text: where each Captain’s golden goods are back in Chests alongside 2X Sprite Dust and XP!
phrases.say: where each Captain’s golden goods are back in Chests alongside double Sprite Dust and XP!

phrases.text: Then, hop aboard for Community Day on 12/5.
phrases.say: Then, hop aboard for Community Day on December 5th.

phrases.text: Starting the 28th means Golden Week starts today.
And one tile left the news. Adventure Awaits! was last up on November 23rd.
Explore One Piece's Arlong Park, sail past Baratie Bay, or storm The $.$. Rocky,
phrases.say: Explore One Piece's Arlong Park, sail past Baratie Bay, or storm The S S Rocky,

phrases.text: That one was about the island itself, and it's gone now.
The other 4 tiles stayed up all week: the Devil Fruits, the TWINDRILL DIVA Music Pass, the Straw Hats outfits and the Multi-Punches Flex.
Now the Item Shop. 17 collab bundles went live this week. Here they are, day by day, with every price.

4,200 V-Bucks, listed at 8,800. It's still in the shop until December 4th.

phrases.text: The biggest gap between the listed price and the real price: the One-Punch Man Bundle, 8,100 V-Bucks apart.
And the most items in one bundle: 18, in the Overwatch Bundle and the One-Punch Man Bundle.
Quick recap. A new version, 43.11. Golden Week from today, and Community Day on December 5th. And 17 collabs in the shop.
Still in the shop after today: Overwatch, Persona 5 Royal, KizunaAI, Puss in Boots, Solo Leveling:ARISE, Daft Punk and Doki Doki Literature Club!.
